command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

BV=$(bracken -v 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $NF}')
# Bracken needs ONLY the read-length distribution file -- not the 633 MiB index.
mkdir -p dbmin && cp database100mers.kmer_distrib dbmin/
bracken -d dbmin -i mix.report -o mix.bracken -r 100 -l S -t 1 > bracken.log 2>&1 || { tail -20 bracken.log; exit 1; }
grep -E 'Total reads kept at species level|Reads distributed|Unclassified reads' bracken.log

KEPT=$(sed -n 's/.*Total reads kept at species level (reads > threshold): \([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' bracken.log)

echo "== Bracken's species table, by abundance =="
awk -F'\t' 'NR>1' mix.bracken | sort -t"$(printf '\t')" -k7,7gr > bk_sorted.tsv
awk -F'\t' '{printf "  %-44s %-9s %6s %9s\n", substr($1,1,43), $2, $6, $7}' bk_sorted.tsv | head -8

echo "== conservation: Bracken redistributes reads, it does not create them =="
SUMEST=$(awk -F'\t' '{n+=$6} END{print n}' bk_sorted.tsv)
test "$SUMEST" = "$KEPT" || { echo "sum(new_est_reads)=$SUMEST but Bracken reports $KEPT kept"; exit 1; }

echo "== identity: each fraction is that species share of the species-level reads =="
awk -F'\t' -v tot="$SUMEST" '{ exp_f = $6/tot
  if (($7 - exp_f) > 1e-5 || (exp_f - $7) > 1e-5) {
    printf "%s fraction %s != %s/%s = %.5f\n", $2, $7, $6, tot, exp_f; bad=1 } }
  END{ if (bad) exit 1; print "  every fraction_total_reads == new_est_reads / " tot }' bk_sorted.tsv

echo "== the dominant species, recovered from ZERO species-rank assignments =="
DOMEST=$(awk -F'\t' '$2==694009{print $6; exit}' bk_sorted.tsv)
DOMFRAC=$(awk -F'\t' '$2==694009{print $7; exit}' bk_sorted.tsv)
test "$DOMEST" = "1000" || { echo "Bracken estimates $DOMEST reads for taxid 694009, planted 1000"; exit 1; }

echo "== rank order must match the planted order =="
awk -F'\t' '{print $3}' planted.tsv > /dev/null   # planted.tsv: taxid, acc, reads, label
sort -t"$(printf '\t')" -k3,3gr planted.tsv | awk -F'\t' 'NR<=3{print $1}' > planted_top3.txt
awk -F'\t' 'NR<=3{print $2}' bk_sorted.tsv > bracken_top3.txt
paste planted_top3.txt bracken_top3.txt
diff -q planted_top3.txt bracken_top3.txt > /dev/null \
  || { echo "top-3 order differs from planted:"; paste planted_top3.txt bracken_top3.txt; exit 1; }

echo "== the case Bracken does NOT fix: a read assigned to the wrong species stays there =="
HBVPLANT=$(awk -F'\t' '$1==10407{print $3}' planted.tsv)
HBVGOT=$(awk -F'\t' 'tolower($1) ~ /hepat|hepadna/ {n+=$6} END{print n+0}' bk_sorted.tsv)
HBVSPP=$(awk -F'\t' 'tolower($1) ~ /hepat|hepadna/ {n++} END{print n+0}' bk_sorted.tsv)
HBVEXACT=$(awk -F'\t' '$2==10407{print $6+0; exit}' bk_sorted.tsv); HBVEXACT=${HBVEXACT:-0}

{
printf 'Bracken -- abundance from a classification, and the two things that separates\n'
printf 'bracken_version\t%s\n' "$BV"
printf 'reads_kept_at_species\t%s\n' "$KEPT"
printf 'sum_new_est_reads\t%s   (assert == reads kept -- CONSERVATION, redistribution not creation)\n' "$SUMEST"
printf 'fraction_identity\tyes   (assert yes -- EXACT: fraction_total_reads == new_est_reads / %s)\n' "$SUMEST"
printf 'dominant_est_reads\t%s   (assert 1000 -- EXACT == planted, recovered from 0 species-rank reads)\n' "$DOMEST"
printf 'dominant_fraction\t%s   (= %s/%s; the planted share of TOTAL reads was 0.50)\n' "$DOMFRAC" "$DOMEST" "$SUMEST"
printf 'top3_order_matches_planted\tyes   (assert yes -- RANK order, the metric that survives redistribution)\n'
printf 'hepadnavirus_planted\t%s reads (taxid 10407, a 3.2 kb genome)\n' "$HBVPLANT"
printf 'hepadnavirus_recovered\t%s reads across %s sibling species; taxid 10407 itself got %s\n' "$HBVGOT" "$HBVSPP" "$HBVEXACT"
printf 'note\tBracken redistributes reads DOWN the tree; it cannot undo a wrong assignment. The\n'
printf 'note\thepatitis B reads were assigned by kraken2 to related hepadnaviruses, and Bracken\n'
printf 'note\tleaves them there -- so 4 planted species come back as 3 correct plus a smear.\n'
printf 'note\tThat is a property of 100 bp reads off a short genome in a crowded family, not a bug,\n'
printf 'note\tand it is why the assertion above is on RANK order and the three unambiguous species.\n'
} | tee smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
